1. Center of the green piece [10,30] — nothing
2. Gray tab of the green piece [10,27] — nothing

Or maybe the click needs to be on a specific pixel of the cross (the black center [10,52] — that's where I clicked; the black center of the cross is [10,52]… wait, the black center of the cross is [10,52], and I clicked there. Nothing happened.
Let me try the following:
4. The red eye of the green piece [10,31]
5. The slot inside the green box (e.g., [21,39])
6. The red eye of the yellow bar [34,10]
7. The lower-left cross [52,10]
Or maybe the mechanic is a drag: MOUSE click-and-drag? But the action is only MOUSE with row/col — a single click. Maybe two clicks: click the piece, then click the destination. I clicked the green piece twice (center, then tab) — no change. Then I clicked the cross.
Or maybe the game is a "Whack-a-Mole" type: the cross appears and you click it… but clicking the cross did nothing.
Wait — maybe the click registers but the piece only moves when it can move (e.g., there's an obstacle in the direction of the eye). The green piece faces right; to its right is the green box at columns 36-48, rows 18-24. The green piece is at rows 9-11. It can't move right because… there's nothing blocking it, it's just empty space. Hmm.
Maybe the piece moves toward the clicked location? I clicked [10,30] (its own body) and [10,27] (its own tab) — both on itself, so no movement. Then I clicked the cross at [10,52] — maybe the green piece should have moved right toward the click? But nothing moved.
Let me try clicking an empty location to the right of the green piece, e.g., [10,40]. If the piece moves toward the click, it should move right.
No, wait. Let me reconsider. Maybe the cross is a "cursor"/pointer that jumps to the clicked location, and the piece moves when the cursor is adjacent? But the cross didn't move when I clicked it.
Or maybe the game requires clicking the eye to "aim" the piece, and then clicking a direction?
Let me try a few systematic probes:
- Click an empty cell to the right of the green piece: [10,40].
- Click the green piece's eye [10,31].
- Click the slot inside the green box [21,39].
Let me execute these one at a time and observe the diff. Actually, to save on the timer, I could batch them in one python call with a diff after each action. The timer shrinks in real time; each action takes about 1 second of real time. Let me batch 3 probes with diffs in one python call.
